prompt:
Technical engineering council (3 seats: steward, code, small). Topic: desktop UI face animation for a local AI assistant.

Given: silent MP4 face clips already on disk; ffmpeg available; local vision models moondream and qwen3-vl:2b; Pocket TTS voice anna on port 8000; CPU-only Ubuntu worker; Windows hub holds the MP4 library.

Design a pipeline:
1) Use ffmpeg to cut clips into short frames/segments.
2) Run a vision model to classify each segment mouth state (closed, open-small, open-wide, round, smile).
3) Build a library of mouth-state stills/segments (blanks).
4) When the LLM returns reply text, Pocket TTS speaks it; a Python stitcher picks mouth blanks timed to TTS audio so the face appears to speak the words.

Output required sections with headings:
A_SEATS: Agree/Amend/Block one line each
B_VISION: which model on CPU and why
C_TAXONOMY: 8 mouth classes + ffmpeg cut notes
D_SYNC: map audio seconds to blank sequence
E_STEPS: P0-P4 with PROOF artifacts
F_RISKS: thermal, disk, sync quality

Be concrete. At least 500 words. No sexual content. This is UI lip-sync for an assistant avatar video player.
